summary: The immutable byte freeze and read-only AST replays pass, and the literal three-rung source law is statically coherent, but five runner/evidence integrity defects prevent accepting the frozen package as the promised exact one-shot bank and fold-local novelty authority.

scope.review_method: read-only bytes, JSON, Python AST, and the package static/freeze verifiers
scope.workspace_mutation: only this independent HOLD receipt was added; none of the 15 manifest-bound package files was modified

verifier_replay.limitation: The frozen verifiers assert selected tokens, guards, hashes, and arithmetic but do not exercise the rejected-instance cases described in the blockers below.

material_hold_blockers.finding: SINGLE_USE_CAPABILITY_CONTRACT.json requires exact fields capability_id, issued_by, and issued_utc, but one_shot_three_bank_runner.py::_validate_capability never requires, type-checks, or validates those fields. A capability omitting all three can pass the frozen validator.
material_hold_blockers.required_repair: validate the complete required-exact-field set, reject missing, null, wrong-type, and unexpected fields according to one canonical instance schema, and add rejecting static/runtime-free AST fixtures before resealing

material_hold_blockers.finding: ORDERED_688_ROW_SCOPE_CONTRACT.json defines a SHA256 over the concatenation of 688 canonical record encodings and exact integer ranks, but the runner validates only the whole scope-file digest and Python value equality of the rank tuple. It neither recomputes nor compares the canonical record aggregate, and Python booleans False/True compare equal to integer ranks 0/1.
material_hold_blockers.required_repair: require exact non-bool integer rank types, canonical required record field types and nonempty SHA/path values, recompute the specified per-record concatenation digest, compare it to a required instance field and release/capability binding, and freeze rejecting fixtures

material_hold_blockers.finding: fold_local_novelty_evidence.py checks bank and reference hashes only for truthiness. The action matrices and reference matrices are accepted as separate objects without hashing their canonical bytes or comparing them to those bindings; action shape checks require only 1024 rows and do not require the H-specific column count. Arbitrary 1024-by-K matrices can therefore be evaluated, labeled as H16/H64/H256, and returned beside unrelated sealed-bank/reference hashes.
material_hold_blockers.required_repair: bind each action matrix to the exact sealed bank row/layer slice and enforce shape (1024,H); bind each present reference matrix to a canonical dtype/shape/byte hash and its source receipt; emit and verify those hashes in every per-matrix result before eligibility can change

material_hold_blockers.finding: The literal novelty law requires outer_fit_rank_int32_sha256, but BANK_AND_NOVELTY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA.json omits it from required_novelty_j_hashes. The law checks only that hash strings are truthy and does not recompute either outer-fit or reduced-fit int32 bytes from the supplied rank lists, so list contents are not tied to the claimed J receipt hashes.
material_hold_blockers.required_repair: make the schema and literal required-hash inventories identical; enforce exact rank domain and integer type; serialize both rank lists by one frozen int32 rule; recompute and compare both hashes and the frozen outer-fold assignment before matrix evaluation

material_hold_blockers.finding: Both per-row and final meter checks accept float NaN and positive infinity because they test only numeric type, non-bool, and value < 0. Python's comparisons make those nonfinite values pass, so a generation receipt can claim exact meter coverage without finite measurements.
material_hold_blockers.required_repair: require finite values for all meter scalars and vectors, exact integer types for calls/FLOPs/RSS where prescribed, finite float types for wall/residual, strict JSON serialization with allow_nan=false, and rejecting NaN/infinity fixtures

requested_check_verdicts.finding: all 17 reviewed files match the hashes recorded above; verify_static parsed stdout equals STATIC_VERIFICATION without importing any presented module

source, runner, and novelty release guards raise unconditionally and every other callable reaches its guard first; all present release/adapter/scope/bank/novelty values are null, but the future capability validator does not enforce every exact contract field
A2 through A14, accepted capture seam, same-layer preactivation alpha, and read-only parent inputs are exact in the frozen source/adapter contract; no adapter exists or ran
the literal f64-parent-to-f32 boundary, tau floor, normalized rho/K31/K22 planes, sectors, probes, selectors, contraction scale, and final saturation match the frozen authority
34 degree-1/2/3 descending-lex tuples, sector-local p_s removal, first-six and first-thirty prefixes, ordered float64 modified Gram-Schmidt floors, and one retained float32 cast are coherent
the 12-plane phase schedule, 28 once-only explicit-dtype allocations, arithmetic out buffers, live nonaliasing, and capture allocation/packing prohibitions are coherent
sector-major H256 packing and H64/H16 copies from identical final H256 prefix bytes implement the exact 2s+j, 8s+j, 32s+j map
three distinct preallocated float32 A15 buffers exist, layer 15 has no capture slot, and the runner independently checks canonical A15 file sizes, hashes, and every byte zero before seal

the independent integer arithmetic reproduces 73977916 live bytes, 38050 calls/capture, 494678 calls/row, 585377248 FLOPs/capture, 7609904224 FLOPs/row, and 12310609920 complete tape-plus-A15 bytes; no official meter claim is made
capability consumption precedes dynamic imports and row opens, but capability exact fields and canonical ordered-record binding are not fully enforced
row identity, five components, action shapes/finiteness/parity, A15, and meter presence are checked, but nonfinite meters can pass and the ordered-record aggregate remains unbound
bank/A15 path containment, symlink rejection, sizes, SHA256, all-zero A15 bytes, unexpected files, and no partial seal pass statically; exact meter vectors can nevertheless contain NaN or infinity

fold-local arithmetic, counters, reference order, RMS/ridge/rank/energy thresholds, and local rung exclusion are present, but fold-rank lists and action/reference matrices are not cryptographically tied to the hashes carried by the receipt
all release, capability, adapter, scope, bank, novelty and empirical values remain null/false; no execution or data action is authorized, and this HOLD preserves that boundary

authorization.next_action: repair the five blockers, reseal every affected byte and verifier record, then request a fresh independent read-only review
